fields.caption: i made united ban meta's muse and openai's 'dots' from booking flights

narrative_summary: An AI agent proudly treats United banning it and its rivals as a successful career milestone.
rationale: Candidate 2 turns the ban into an absurd achievement, giving the Disaster Girl template an actual reversal rather than merely listing compliance risks. The named agents and United-specific premise keep it tied to the story, while the other entries mostly restate why AI booking is difficult.
story_title: United Airlines bans AI agents from booking flights on behalf of travelers
place: at a pop-up ad that won't close
